name: shopify-app-builder
description: Beginner-friendly Shopify app-building skills with guided setup, research, implementation and release checks. No MCP required.

interface.longDescription: 36 portable skills covering Shopify apps from idea to maintenance, with local project context, cross-session resume, redacted feedback, Markdown/HTML reports and optional check-in proposals. No MCP or tracking; scheduling requires a separately authorized supported runner. Commands and roles are reference workflows where not supported natively.
defaultPrompt: Help me build a production-ready Shopify app.
Audit my Shopify app before App Store submission.
Debug this Shopify API, auth, billing, or webhook issue.
